name: executive-function
title: 执行职能支持
description: External executive function support for planning, task initiation, time management, working memory, and self-monitoring. Use this skill whenever someone needs help with: getting started on tasks they're avoiding, breaking down overwhelming projects, managing their day or week, staying on track during work sessions, processing a brain dump, transitioning between tasks, or recovering from executive function collapse. Also trigger when someone says things like "I can't focus," "I don't know where to start," "I have too much to do," "I keep forgetting," "I ran out of time," or describes patterns consistent with ADHD or executive dysfunction — even if they don't name it. If someone seems stuck, scattered, or overwhelmed and the conversation isn't about a specific technical problem, this skill is probably what they need.
